assessment: Selected celery-allergic cohort with primary abstract only. Caraway was clinically relevant in 26%, with symptoms and preparation at participant level unresolved.

disposition: dated powdered form used on skin
assessment: Native powdered caraway was explicitly included in skin prick tests. Reported symptoms are pooled across spices.

Abstract lists two caraway cases. The primary manuscript body describes symptoms after cumin and confirmed celery anaphylaxis, with caraway skin or basophil tests. No botanically verified oral caraway challenge or voice outcome.
Spice protein and IgE binding research. Sera and laboratory outcomes do not quantify symptoms after a food challenge.
Follow-up characterization of caraway nonspecific lipid transfer protein. This reports molecular measurements.
Hypophonesis on emergency exam concerns auscultatory or percussion sounds. The paper provides neither a voice test nor a causal effect of ground caraway.
Same original Czech case used for 0933. Oral burning and respiratory distress occur in a mixed-meal setting, with no reported speech or voice score.
HESA-A contains named Carum carvi in a powder combination, after acute poisoning. Dysarthria is listed among candidate pretreatment signs and was not a post-treatment outcome.
The head and neck cancer survey combines caraway with cumin and discusses traditional uses. Speech and loudness were not measured.
The human listener study uses the words caraway seeds in a stimulus sentence. There was no caraway ingestion.
Mention of apathy is a citation in the Discussion. The test was odor recognition with dried spice. The dissertation chapter and 2022 article are paired.
The caraway odor item is in a discrimination panel. Motor and apathy terms elsewhere in the abstract volume belong to other studies.
The (+)-carvone test showed no clear alertness, mood or calmness effects and measured blood pressure. This reports a context-specific inhalation result.
Open-field crossings and forced-task immobility were measured. Neither directly measures apathy severity.
Chemically verified caraway seed essential oil increased food intake in mice following fasting and inhalation. The intervention did not include consuming toasted caraway.

disposition: health cohort with independent language and odor assessments
assessment: The 59-person subset rated caraway odor. MoCA language measures were separate, and neurodegenerative disease was excluded.

disposition: carvone vapor with abstract stereochemistry ambiguity
assessment: The (+) form is linked to caraway in the text. The title's R/S pairing and reagent identity require full provenance before pooling that enantiomer.
Both induced hyperactivity models and an S-carvone activity suppression result. The study did not assess apathy, dystonia or handwriting.

disposition: rotarod and seizure outcomes already cataloged
assessment: Injected extract and oil did not clearly alter aggregate rotarod retention. No relevant disease model or specific motor skill assessment.
Early beam interruption counts reflected spontaneous movement, with no rest-tremor, dystonia, apathy or micrographia scale.

disposition: oral oil and rat movement in an aluminum model
assessment: Both conditions increased simple activity counts. Separate symptom and culinary preparations were not examined.

disposition: body tremor during acute isolated-compound toxicity
assessment: The 2012 dossier reports occasional body tremor in two rats, with unspecified isomer ratio and high acute exposure. The underlying 2000 assessment report was not separately verified.

disposition: distinct original NTP d-carvone rodent study
assessment: Gavage protocol measured systemic toxicity and carcinogenicity in mice. The dataset differs from the OECD 401 rat account of occasional body tremor.

disposition: chemically modified compound in seizure model
assessment: Cyano-carvone did not reverse pilocarpine-associated tremors and stereotypies. This is a separate synthetic derivative, and no ground caraway or Parkinson rest tremor was tested.
Caraway solvent extracts suppressed induced CYP1A1. CYP1A2 and levodopa interaction remained unmeasured.

disposition: caraway seed fraction and rat drug exposure
assessment: The seed fraction increased exposure to three tuberculosis drugs. The follow-up human study used the prior extraction method in a different cohort.

disposition: caraway extract and human drug exposure
assessment: Fixed-order crossover detected higher plasma exposures to three tuberculosis drugs. No Parkinson pharmacotherapy, symptom response or P-glycoprotein assay.

disposition: oral human combination with chemical uptake endpoints
assessment: Carvone and menthol plasma measurements concern the product's own components. Carvone AUC confidence interval does not meet the lower equivalence bound.

disposition: exact raw ground caraway in unrelated trial
assessment: The pulmonary-tuberculosis trial's registry and primary publication were already cataloged. Their recorded outcomes do not address the six frozen symptoms or Parkinson-drug PK.
